tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. The cache is positional: agent() calls replay from cache up to the first call that failed, no longer matches the earlier run (edited, added, removed or reordered) or never started in it; that call and every call after it run again, even when their own (prompt, opts) are unchanged. A call a usage limit refused, or one still running when the run stopped, usually runs again without ending reuse: finished calls after it still come from cache. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

# OLMo 3.5 Small (A4B) on B300

Measured MILES RL layouts for OLMo 3.5 Small ("Hero Small", A4B,
`olmo35-small-e256k8-sh2x`) on `ai2/holmes` B300 nodes. Configs:
[two-node-mech](../../configs/miles/examples/small/two-node-mech.toml),
[four-node](../../configs/miles/examples/small/four-node.toml) and
[eight-node](../../configs/miles/examples/small/eight-node.toml). The current recipes
use the Tiny batch/LR/loss baseline from PR #2271; historical measurements below
used the earlier settings. They run four mechanics or 30 timing updates without
checkpoints and do not establish learning quality.

## Model and start checkpoint

- Start checkpoint: H203 SFT export
  `/weka/olmo-3p5-post-checkpoints/abhishekr/a4b-gpu/a4bgpu-s34521/hf_step18410`
  (`Olmo3MoeForCausalLM`, bf16, 72.58B parameters / 145.16 GB).
- 40 layers: 35 KDA plus full attention at layers 7, 15, 23, 31 and 39 (NoPE, head_dim 256);
  256 routed experts top-8 (latent MoE dim 768, `moe_intermediate_size` 3072), shared expert,
  dense layer 0; hidden 1536; untied LM head.
- Export notes: the `emo_*` fields are all null in this SFT export (the base export has
  EMo 8/256/256), so it is used as-is with no config edit. The HF config has
  `vocab_size` 100278 (LM head `[100278, 1536]`); 100352 is Core's padded size.
- Data: robertb's H196 Dolci inputs
  (`/weka/olmo-3p5-post-checkpoints/robertb/miles/h196-dolci-control-20261113/inputs/`,
  84,577 rendered rows). Its rendering was made for Tiny but uses the same tokenizer and chat
  template as this export. There is no held-out split, so do not set `training.eval_interval`.
- Code verifier needs `CODE_EXECUTION_TOKEN`. Each recipe maps it to a placeholder
  Beaker secret name under `[launch.secrets]`; replace that name with a secret in the
  selected workspace. Never put the token value in the TOML. The historical timing
  runs omitted this credential: code samples were ungraded and their groups dropped
  (3-36 groups per update). Runs with code grading enabled have a different effective
  workload; remeasure throughput rather than assuming the historical timings apply.

## Layout and memory

| Config | Nodes | Trainer | Engines | Judge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| two-node-mech | 2 | 8 GPUs, EP8 | 7 × TP1 | 1 × Qwen3-32B |
| four-node | 4 | 8 GPUs, EP8 | 23 × TP1 | 1 × Qwen3-32B |
| eight-node | 8 | 16 GPUs, 2 nodes × EP8 | 47 × TP1 | 1 × Qwen3-32B |

- Trainer (EP8, 4 nodes): peak reserved 220.5 GiB of 268.6 GiB per B300 (rank 0 peak
  allocated 209.7 GiB). With 2 × EP8 (8 nodes): 169.7 GiB. Packs are 34,816 tokens, below the
  OLMo-core no-grad Triton SwiGLU int32 overflow at 43,690 tokens per forward.
- Engine at R=96: weights 135 GB; KDA state for 128 slots 17.9 GB (SSM 17.64 + conv 0.21);
  KV for 3,342,336 tokens 63.8 GB (K 31.88 + V 31.88); about 50 GB free after pools at
  `mem_fraction_static` 0.88.

## Settings that matter

- `sglang_attention_backend = "trtllm_mha"` for the 5 full-attention layers. On one engine with
  96 forced 4K decodes: 2,881 tok/s vs 2,473 with triton. `fa4` crashes the server: "SM100
  forward with head_dim=256 does not support seqused_q/seqused_k".
- Tuned fused-MoE tiles (`SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR`, see
  [moe_configs](../../configs/miles/moe_configs/README.md)): kernel -9% at batch 96, decode
  +1.6% at R=96. The tiles only take effect in an image built with this branch's
  `configs/miles`; an older image has no file at that path.
- `OLMO_SGLANG_CORE_COMPAT = "rounding"`. The attention trial's HF vs SGLang
  samples have mean |Δlogprob| 0.0155-0.0223 and argmax agreement 98.2-99.4%.
- Admission R=96: `sglang_max_running_requests` 96, `sglang_max_mamba_cache_size` 128,
  `sglang_server_concurrency` 192, `sglang_cuda_graph_max_bs_decode` 96, producer budget
  `async_max_concurrent_samples` = 96 × engines.
- Judge: `timeout = 600` and `chat_template = "qwen3-no-thinking"`. The judge bindings use the
  hashed verifier ids in the H196 `verifiers.json`.
- `two-node-mech` enables the initial serving-weight comparison and repeats the
  standalone/training scoring check every update. These qualification checks add
  overhead relative to the original mechanics run and remain off in timing recipes
  (which retain the default startup scoring check).
- The four/eight-node recipes request 4h/3h of protected runtime, respectively,
  based on historical startup and update times plus headroom, with an 8h timeout.
  Revisit these budgets when enabling code grading or other additional work.

## Results

The table below was independently recomputed from retained Beaker artifacts on
November 18, 2026. Updates 10-29 unless noted, 128 prompts × 8 samples, max response
32,768 tokens. A cycle starts at `generation_wait.started_unix` and ends at
`publication.started_unix + publication.seconds` for the same update. Startup,
final drain and checkpoint/evaluation work are excluded. Each column is its own
median; component medians need not sum to the cycle median. Earlier headline cycle
...
# Tuned SGLang fused-MoE kernel configs

`configs/triton_3_7_1/E=256,N=3072,device_name=NVIDIA_B300_SXM6_AC.json` holds the
Triton fused-MoE tiles for OLMo 3.5 Small (A4B: 256 routed experts, top-8,
`moe_intermediate_size` 3072, latent MoE dim 768) on B300 with Triton 3.7.1 and TP1.

- Generated by SGLang's MoE tuner (`benchmark/kernels/fused_moe_triton/tuning_fused_moe_triton.py`,
  288-config search space, batch sizes 1-8192) on one B300 in Beaker job `kf-hero-miles-moetune`
  (01M7CQZXJFJJANTT9ESVCVC04H, image 01M7A0QM57N9499PGFAT73SMF0). The tuner needed a local
  patch so that `Olmo3MoeForCausalLM` uses `latent_moe_dim` as the GEMM K dimension.
- This copy was rebuilt from the tuner job's per-batch-size log lines (the values SGLang
  loaded from the original file), not copied byte-for-byte. A subsequent audit fetched
  the original JSON from that experiment's result dataset and confirmed identical
  parsed contents for every batch-size entry.
- The image copies `configs/miles` to `/opt/core-rl/configs/miles`, so the Small examples set
  `SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR = "/opt/core-rl/configs/miles/moe_configs"`. The server logs
  "Using MoE kernel config from ...", then reports that the `_down` file is missing and
  reuses these tiles for the down projection.
- Measured effect: fused-MoE kernel -9% at batch 96 (565.7 -> 514.6 us), end-to-end decode
  +1.6% at R=96 and +4.4% at R=192; parity with HF unchanged. See docs/miles/olmo35-small.md.
- The directory name must match the image's Triton version (`triton_3_7_1`); rename it if the
  pinned Triton changes.

+    judge_registry.validate_data({"prompt_data": str(path)}, value)
+
+
+def test_unused_c033_binding_is_allowed_for_dolci_subset(document, tmp_path):
+    document["rubrics"]["abstention"] = {"profile": "nvidia/qa-abstention-v1", "max_response_tokens": 64}

+    value = judging.registry(judging.parse(document))
+    path = tmp_path / "rows.jsonl"
+    path.write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {"metadata": {"judge_query": "Question", "verifiers": [{"name": "general-quality", "target": None}]}}
+        )
+        + "\n"
+    )
+    judge_registry.validate_data({"prompt_data": str(path)}, value)
+    assert set(value["bindings"]) == {"general-quality", "abstention"}
+

+    else:
+        row["metadata"]["verifiers"][0]["target"] = None

+    path.write_text(json.dumps(row) + "\n")

295:**答案**：换算公式是 \[ \text{num\_rollout} = \text{num\_epoch} \times \left\lfloor \frac{\text{dataset\_size}}{\text{rollout\_batch\_size}} \right\rfloor \] 其中 `dataset_size` 要等准备好的数据加载之后才知道。编译承诺不读数据文件，所以只能把 `num_epoch` 原样透传，由原生 MILES 在数据加载后换算；保存节奏也因此退化为 `save_final_checkpoint`（只保最终更新）而不是编造 `save_interval`。
371:**`num_epoch` 的正整数检查**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py:649-651](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/28c1816664491493242d453c2c7280ee56e6c20a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L649-L651)：`num_epoch` 与 `num_rollout`、`rollout_batch_size` 等同列「必须为正整数」名单，传 `0`、负数或布尔值都会被拒——注意 Python 里 `True` 是 `int` 子类，所以这里用 `type(options[name]) is not int` 严格排除了布尔。

295:**答案**：换算公式是 \[ \text{num\_rollout} = \text{num\_epoch} \times \left\lfloor \frac{\text{dataset\_size}}{\text{rollout\_batch\_size}} \right\rfloor \] 其中 `dataset_size` 要等准备好的数据加载之后才知道。编译承诺不读数据文件，所以只能把 `num_epoch` 原样透传，由原生 MILES 在数据加载后换算；保存节奏也因此退化为 `save_final_checkpoint`（只保最终更新）而不是编造 `save_interval`。
371:**`num_epoch` 的正整数检查**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py:649-651](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/28c1816664491493242d453c2c7280ee56e6c20a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L649-L651)：`num_epoch` 与 `num_rollout`、`rollout_batch_size` 等同列「必须为正整数」名单，传 `0`、负数或布尔值都会被拒——注意 Python 里 `True` 是 `int` 子类，所以这里用 `type(options[name]) is not int` 严格排除了布尔。
575:**维护示例的新声明**。[configs/miles/examples/README.md:25-31](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/28c1816664491493242d453c2c7280ee56e6c20a/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L25-L31)：示例除 `calculate_per_token_loss=false` 与 `reward_zero_truncated=true` 外，现在还必须保持 presented-response grading（`reward_final_answer_only=true`）；示例统一声明 `reward_reasoning_mode="required"`，非思考策略/模板必须显式用 `"none"`；process 与边界格式奖励需要声明的例外见 grading.md。[README.md:302-316](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/28c1816664491493242d453c2c7280ee56e6c20a/configs/miles/examples/README.md#L302-L316) 记录评估采样协议：策略评估用 temperature 1.0 / top-p 0.95，后台任务显式请求 32768 响应 token，in-loop 评估默认对齐同一采样并把继承的响应预算截到 32K，显式覆盖仍然胜出；裁判采样与训练 rollout 采样相互独立。

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.


### Removed
- Remove the Small `dev.toml` placeholder that used a Tiny checkpoint; direct Small mechanics checks to the tested two-node recipe (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2280).
- Remove the dataset readiness scripts (`scripts/data/rl_readiness/`), the standalone IF-target filter and the first-pass data handoff page; the RL Data Workbench now owns qualification, screening and release evidence, while Open Instruct keeps source adapters, catalog resolution, verifiers and the training loader (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2220).

### Changed
- Allow unused MILES judge bindings when a dataset subset omits their verifiers, preserving required-binding and active grading checks (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2286).
- Use 2,048-response optimizer batches at constant LR 6e-6 in Tiny MILES learning examples and token-mean loss in all maintained MILES examples, preserving omitted library defaults (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2271).
- Align every Small MILES recipe with the Tiny baseline from #2271: 2,048-response batches at constant LR 6e-6 with no warmup and token-mean loss; retain historical timing provenance (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2280).
- Retain terminal unused-work accounting after MILES refresh cancellation and audit Small timing recipes against the original Beaker artifacts, including the completed R160 trial and corrected score diagnostics (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2280).
- Cancel unused MILES refresh generation during terminal cleanup so completed training runs do not wait for surplus responses; add Small B300 recipes with code-service credentials and mechanics qualification checks (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2280).
- Enable native MILES score-centering TIS/MIS in Core refresh runs, validate candidate settings before launch, and pin the complete-support precision fixes (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2229).
- Organize MILES examples by model family and explicitly configure candidate policy evaluation sampling, including shared and OPD in-loop defaults (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2255).
- Add the native Nemotron abstention QA adapter and named three-tier judge profile, preserving NVIDIA's rubric and answer extraction while keeping judge failures ungraded (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2252).
- Allow priority-first prompt ordering within uniform and exposure MILES pools, preserving independent pool progression, trained-group accounting and resumable disk-backed inventories (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2256).
- Honor native MILES num_epoch budgets without injecting a conflicting rollout default; save epoch-run final checkpoints and recognize the runtime-resolved completion limit (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2251).
- Enable final-answer grading in the three maintained MILES examples while preserving the library default. Keep exclusion tables aligned with grading-aware record keys, reject cross-contract evidence, and validate native reward contracts before worker startup (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2250).
- Give MILES final-answer grading shared thinking/response views, explicit per-verifier input and eligibility policies, non-thinking and prompt-prefilled-closure support, per-component selection provenance and distinct evidence identities. Preserve default-off scoring; document every path in `docs/miles/grading.md` with validation evidence in the PR (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2250).
- Keep shared grading selection separate from legacy task normalization; send intact selected text to named quality judges in final-answer mode, preserving answer wrappers, whitespace and surrounding prose. Version the changed contract and document per-consumer contracts (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2250).
- Declare answer, process, format and composite grading objectives; migrate 16 native consumer entry points to authoritative selected inputs while retaining task parsers and flag-off behavior. Record ToolRL's separate format/full and correctness/response inputs and version the grading evidence contract (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2250).
- Validate grading syntax during preparation without overriding factory defaults, and retain explicit grading policies through named-judge binding replacements and prepared-data resume checks (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2250).
- Preserve ToolRL's original boundary-format context while grading its selected final action, and keep actual trajectory tokens for token-length verifiers in MILES final-answer mode (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2250).
- Include the qualified ReasoningGym/RDKit libraries and an in-tree complete-code HTTP client in MILES application images, with offline build-time grader checks, external install caches, and runtime Beaker secret references (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2248).
- Default structured MILES runs' W&B group to the run name when omitted, preventing tracking startup from failing when the native random suffix is enabled; explicit groups remain unchanged (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2243).
- Guard MILES Math-Verify equation references with a cached false-equation probe; references accepting `1 + 2 = 8` use equation-side comparison while retaining scalar and matrix assignment answers, including after probe timeouts, preserving answer anchors while blocking the unsafe Math-Verify path (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2243).
- Stop NeMo single-step tool rows crediting unfinished reasoning: the verifier now grades only the text after the reasoning block, so a response whose reasoning never closes scores zero (it used to earn full credit on reply rows, where any text counts) and calls drafted inside unfinished reasoning no longer count as actions. The reward step reads each sample's rendered prompt to tell the verifier whether the prompt opened the reasoning block; prepared labels are unchanged (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/2232).

learning_goals: 读懂 build_image_and_launch.sh 的构建与提交流程

掌握 padding-free/序列打包如何节省显存
能对比两种 collator 的张量形状

learning_goals: 掌握 messages 数据规范与角色约定
理解 data_types.py 中工具调用/统计相关的数据结构

lectures.title: 数据制备脚本实战：scripts/data

lectures.title: dpo.py：DPO 主流程与 OLMo-core 路线

lectures.title: DPO 家族损失函数：dpo_loss / simpo / wpo

lectures.title: Online DPO 概览

lectures.title: 合成偏好数据：LLM 裁判与 pairwise 构造

learning_goals: 理解 GRPO 训练的整体编排

lectures.practice_task: 用 grpo_fast_resource_plan 的逻辑为「4 卡、1 个 vLLM 引擎」推演一份分配方案，并对照 test_grpo_fast_resource_plan.py 的断言验证你的推演。
lectures.title: 权重同步、资源规划与训练回调

call_8151ec76c78641c79c447790.rationale: 本轮增量（28c181666→2f7889da9）共三个提交，全部落在 MILES。其一，#2271 把维护示例的损失基线从 per-response 翻转为 token-mean（所有示例 calculate_per_token_loss=true，库省略默认仍保留 response-mean 兼容），Tiny 学习示例统一为 256 prompts × 8、batch 2048、恒定 LR 6e-6 无 warmup，examples README、development-defaults、grpo.md、run-controls、throughput-profiles 同步改写——已落盘的 u8-l1（small 目录故事与练习引用已删除的 small/dev.toml）与 u8-l2（基线表述与练习步骤）不再准确，均转 update。其二，#2280 删除 small/dev.toml 占位、新增实测的 OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B，KDA+MoE）B300 三档配方（two-node-mech/four-node/eight-node）、configs/miles/moe_configs 的 SGLang fused-MoE tile 调优文件与 README、230 行的 docs/miles/olmo35-small.md（布局/显存账目/吞吐审计/失败记录），并把 driver.py 终端刷新清理改为无条件 abort 未完成工作——实测配方体系在 u8 拓扑与吞吐主题下自成一讲，新增 u8-l15（依赖讲配置系统的 u8-l2 与讲拓扑吞吐的 u8-l10）；driver 的终端清理小改并入 u8-l3（update）。其三，#2286 允许 judge 绑定表覆盖数据子集未使用的绑定（judge_registry.validate_data 删除 unused 报错，active 绑定的 judge_query/引用目标校验保留，managed-judges.md 记录，test_miles_judging.py 补用例），直接落进 u8-l6（update 扩充）与以 abstention 绑定为动机案例的 u8-l13（new，扩充目标与实践）。上一轮已落盘且本轮内容不受影响的 u1-l1、u1-l2、u6-l3、u6-l6、u6-l7、u6-l8、u7-l4、u8-l4、u8-l11 置 keep；上一轮尚未落盘的 u8-l5、u8-l8、u8-l9 的 update 与 u8-l12～l14 的 new 继续保留；SFT/DPO/RM/GRPO/OLMo-core 其余各篇与工程化单元无变化，全部保持原动作。

data.rationale: 本轮增量（28c181666→2f7889da9）共三个提交，全部落在 MILES。其一，#2271 把维护示例的损失基线从 per-response 翻转为 token-mean（所有示例 calculate_per_token_loss=true，库省略默认仍保留 response-mean 兼容），Tiny 学习示例统一为 256 prompts × 8、batch 2048、恒定 LR 6e-6 无 warmup，examples README、development-defaults、grpo.md、run-controls、throughput-profiles 同步改写——已落盘的 u8-l1（small 目录故事与练习引用已删除的 small/dev.toml）与 u8-l2（基线表述与练习步骤）不再准确，均转 update。其二，#2280 删除 small/dev.toml 占位、新增实测的 OLMo 3.5 Small（A4B，KDA+MoE）B300 三档配方（two-node-mech/four-node/eight-node）、configs/miles/moe_configs 的 SGLang fused-MoE tile 调优文件与 README、230 行的 docs/miles/olmo35-small.md（布局/显存账目/吞吐审计/失败记录），并把 driver.py 终端刷新清理改为无条件 abort 未完成工作——实测配方体系在 u8 拓扑与吞吐主题下自成一讲，新增 u8-l15（依赖讲配置系统的 u8-l2 与讲拓扑吞吐的 u8-l10）；driver 的终端清理小改并入 u8-l3（update）。其三，#2286 允许 judge 绑定表覆盖数据子集未使用的绑定（judge_registry.validate_data 删除 unused 报错，active 绑定的 judge_query/引用目标校验保留，managed-judges.md 记录，test_miles_judging.py 补用例），直接落进 u8-l6（update 扩充）与以 abstention 绑定为动机案例的 u8-l13（new，扩充目标与实践）。上一轮已落盘且本轮内容不受影响的 u1-l1、u1-l2、u6-l3、u6-l6、u6-l7、u6-l8、u7-l4、u8-l4、u8-l11 置 keep；上一轮尚未落盘的 u8-l5、u8-l8、u8-l9 的 update 与 u8-l12～l14 的 new 继续保留；SFT/DPO/RM/GRPO/OLMo-core 其余各篇与工程化单元无变化，全部保持原动作。

lectures.topic: 精读 execution 包：workflow 的准备/训练/导出三阶段与指纹恢复、driver 协调 rollout 与优化器更新、cluster.Supervisor 的受监管启动；此前更新：run 完成判定改用 driver 结果中的 num_rollout，epoch 预算 run 通过 save_final_checkpoint 在最终更新时保存，driver 新增 rewards.validate_registry 启动校验，workflow.execute 在 run_directory 与模型准备之前新增 evaluation.validate_scicode_reference_path 预检（SciCode 秘密链路详见 u8-l9）。本轮小更新（#2280）：driver 的终端刷新清理改为无条件 abort——成功结束的 run 也不等待未完成的推理收尾工作，因为全部请求的训练更新完成后排空剩余长响应可能超时。

lectures.topic: 讲解 MILES 新增的统一判分输入层：grading.py 的 split_response 一次性切分 thinking 与 delivered response（含 prompt 预填闭合思考、非思考模式、重开推理等门控），GradingPolicy 用 objective×scope×require_response 为每个验证器声明输入契约，rewards._VerifierRegistry 加载期解析策略并在 driver 启动前校验（外部工厂必须声明 grading 或实现 parts 协议），ground_truth_utils 消费者经 selected_input 直通，复合消费者经 async_call_parts 取得分组件输入，推理记录与选择表以 schema 2 携带 grading 契约防止新旧证据混用。

learning_goals: 理解 nemo_abstention_v1 源契约：保留原始 system/user 问题、闭卷（禁止 tools）、输出结构化 question/answer 目标并校验

learning_goals: 理解 PriorityPromptProvider 的组序遍历：每个 epoch 内按组 1→2→3→4 依序耗尽、组内无采样权重

理解确定性（seed 固定组内洗牌、identity 哈希拒绝不匹配的 resume）与 provider_source 的接入方式
